verdict.rationale: Rive's runtimes expose a programmatic Renderer interface (rive-gh-1, rive-gh-2) and docs describe 'export once' across platforms (rive-docs-7/8) plus MCP/RML surfaces for agents to build files programmatically (rive-docs-9/10/19/20, rive-probe-rt-2), but this only covers exporting the interactive .riv format to runtimes, not documented screenshot/image/video export. Community hands-on reports explicitly contradict export of static/movie assets ('no way to export movie files', 'can I export video assets with this!?') (rive-comm-3, rive-comm-10), directly undermining the 'render and export images/production formats' claim. Missing for 10: a documented API/CLI for rasterized image or video export, and resolution of the community-reported export gap.
